The [[Ghost]] of [[Marchena]], who is angry that he was killed by [[Minotaur (Crystal Desert)|Minotaurs]], asks you to slay ten Minotaurs in [[Prophet's Path]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* [0..10]/10 Minotaurs slain.
* Return to Marchena for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* {{w}} {{skill icon|Shield Bash}}
* {{r}} {{skill icon|Dust Trap}}
* {{mo}} {{skill icon|Blessed Aura}}
* {{n}} {{skill icon|Malaise}}
* {{me}} {{skill icon|Mantra of Persistence}}
* {{e}} {{skill icon|Obsidian Flame}}

==Walkthrough==
Kill 10 Minotaurs anywhere in Prophet's Path. [[Mob]]s of Minotaurs can be found [[patrol]]ling Prophet's Path. A large group of Minotaurs lies west past the [[teleporter]] in Prophet's Path. The 10 kills can be done in more than one [[instance]].

Alternatively, take this quest on reaching Augury Rock, then play through the desert as normal.  Any Minotaurs encountered in the desert will count for this quest. You will also face enough Minotaurs during the beginning of the [[Elona Reach]] mission to satisfy this quest.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Marchena
:''You've come here to [[Ascend]] have you? I suggest you watch out for the '''minotaurs''' if you head into '''Prophet's Path'''. It was those damnable bull-headed monstrosities that slew me many years ago. It really raises my ire that they still live while I am doomed to wander this desert as a ghost! If you are going to Prophet's Path, could you do me the rather small favor of slaying some of those hell-spawned cows for me? '''10''' of them should suffice, and I can make it worth your while.''

:''How does that sound?''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Sounds rather easy.
| decline = Not worth my time.
| ask = I ask for so little from you! Simply slay '''10 minotaurs''' and then return to me.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Marchena
:''Down with those damnable minotaurs! Ahh...I can almost hear their final breath rattle out of them as they lay on the sand mangled and bleeding and...oh, sorry...I got a little carried away there. A deal is a deal. You have my thanks.''

==Notes==
* Any Minotaur killed anywhere in the Crystal Desert, e.g. during the [[Elona Reach]] [[mission]], also counts for this quest.

*You do not need to be the one who kills the Minotaur; as long as you are within compass range when a Minotaur is killed (by other party members, or local monsters) the kill will be credited to you, and will be noted in the quest log.
*Minotaurs in the Shiverpeaks do not count for this quest.
{{anomaly|Boss minotaurs may not count towards the quest.}}
